﻿# Operational Readiness Test

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../README.md) • [Governance](../README.md) • [Governing Bodies](./README.md)**

---

> Gate 4 governing body responsible for production readiness validation and support procedures for all systems entering production environments.

---
page_texts.2:
[governance/governing-bodies/operational-readiness-test-review.md#governing-body-overview]

## Governing Body Overview

**Purpose**: Production readiness validation and support procedures for all systems entering production environments.

**Charter**: The Operational Readiness Test (ORT) ensures that all systems, applications, and infrastructure components are fully prepared for production deployment with appropriate operational support, monitoring, and maintenance procedures in place.

**Body Type**: Decision-Making (has formal authority to approve, reject, or mandate changes)

**Gate Authority**: Gate 4 - Operational Readiness Test (ORT) Process in the 6-gate governance framework

**GainwellNow Enterprise Architecture Governance**: [Submit ORT Request](https://gainwellnow.service-now.com/esc?id=sc_cat_item&sys_id=3d2faedac356ce908978decf050131f6)

---
page_texts.3:
[governance/governing-bodies/operational-readiness-test-review.md#composition]

## Composition

| Role                          | Representative                      | Responsibilities                                            | Participation |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- |
| **Chair**                     | Operations Manager                  | Operational oversight, readiness validation, final approval | Required      |
| **Enterprise Architecture**   | Principal Enterprise Architect/CTO  | Strategic oversight and enterprise alignment                | As Needed     |
| **Infrastructure Operations** | Senior Infrastructure Engineer      | Infrastructure readiness, capacity validation               | Required      |
| **Application Operations**    | Senior Application Support Engineer | Application support procedures, operational documentation   | Required      |
| **Security Operations**       | Security Operations Representative  | Security monitoring, incident response procedures           | Required      |
| **Database Operations**       | Database Administrator              | Database operations, backup procedures, performance         | Required      |
| **Monitoring and Support**    | System Monitoring Specialist        | Monitoring setup, alerting configuration, dashboard setup   | Required      |

**Meeting Frequency**: Weekly for production deployments, on-demand for urgent releases
**Decision Scope and Authority**: Production readiness approval, operational support validation, go-live authorization

page_texts.5:
[governance/governing-bodies/operational-readiness-test-review.md#required-information]

### Required Information

- **Deployment Procedures**: Complete deployment automation and rollback procedures
- **Monitoring Configuration**: Operational monitoring, alerting, and dashboard setup
- **Support Documentation**: Incident response procedures, troubleshooting guides, escalation paths
- **Performance Baselines**: System performance expectations and capacity planning
- **Security Validation**: Security compliance verification and operational security procedures
page_texts.6:
[governance/governing-bodies/operational-readiness-test-review.md#decision-criteria]

### Decision Criteria

- **Operational Readiness**: Complete operational procedures and support capabilities
- **Monitoring Coverage**: Comprehensive monitoring and alerting configuration
- **Support Procedures**: Documented incident response and support escalation
- **Performance Validation**: Verified system performance and capacity
- **Security Compliance**: Operational security procedures and compliance validation

---
page_texts.8:
[governance/governing-bodies/operational-readiness-test-review.md#primary-activities]

### Primary Activities

- **Readiness Assessment**: Evaluate complete operational readiness for production deployment
- **Support Validation**: Verify operational support procedures and capabilities
- **Monitoring Review**: Validate monitoring, alerting, and dashboard configuration
- **Performance Verification**: Confirm system performance meets operational requirements
- **Documentation Review**: Ensure complete operational documentation and procedures
page_texts.9:
[governance/governing-bodies/operational-readiness-test-review.md#key-deliverables]

### Key Deliverables

- **Production Readiness Approval**: Formal authorization for production deployment
- **Operational Support Certification**: Validation of support procedures and capabilities
- **Monitoring Configuration Approval**: Verification of monitoring and alerting setup
- **Performance Baseline Documentation**: Established performance expectations and thresholds
- **Operational Runbook Approval**: Validated operational procedures and documentation
page_texts.10:
[governance/governing-bodies/operational-readiness-test-review.md#review-scope]

### Review Scope

The ORT evaluates systems for:
page_texts.11:
[governance/governing-bodies/operational-readiness-test-review.md#infrastructure-readiness]

#### Infrastructure Readiness

- **Capacity Planning**: Adequate infrastructure capacity and scaling procedures
- **Deployment Automation**: Complete deployment and rollback automation
- **Environment Configuration**: Production environment setup and validation
- **Network Configuration**: Network connectivity, security, and performance
- **Backup Procedures**: Data backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures
page_texts.12:
[governance/governing-bodies/operational-readiness-test-review.md#application-operations]

#### Application Operations

- **Application Monitoring**: Application-level monitoring and health checks
- **Log Management**: Centralized logging, log retention, and analysis capabilities
- **Performance Monitoring**: Application performance metrics and thresholds
- **Configuration Management**: Application configuration and change procedures
- **Dependency Management**: External dependency monitoring and failover procedures
page_texts.13:
[governance/governing-bodies/operational-readiness-test-review.md#support-procedures]

#### Support Procedures

- **Incident Response**: Complete incident response procedures and escalation paths
- **Troubleshooting Guides**: Comprehensive troubleshooting documentation
- **Support Training**: Operations team training and knowledge transfer completion
- **Communication Procedures**: Stakeholder communication and status reporting procedures
- **Change Management**: Production change procedures and approval workflows
page_texts.14:
[governance/governing-bodies/operational-readiness-test-review.md#security-operations]

#### Security Operations

- **Security Monitoring**: Security event monitoring and alerting configuration
- **Access Controls**: Production access controls and authentication procedures
- **Compliance Monitoring**: Ongoing compliance monitoring and reporting
- **Security Incident Response**: Security-specific incident response procedures
- **Audit Capabilities**: Audit logging and compliance reporting capabilities
page_texts.15:
[governance/governing-bodies/operational-readiness-test-review.md#performance-and-capacity]

#### Performance and Capacity

- **Performance Baselines**: Established performance expectations and monitoring
- **Capacity Monitoring**: Resource utilization monitoring and alerting
- **Scaling Procedures**: Automated and manual scaling procedures
- **Performance Testing**: Production performance validation and stress testing
- **Capacity Planning**: Long-term capacity planning and forecasting

---
page_texts.17:
[governance/governing-bodies/operational-readiness-test-review.md#gateway-flow]

### Gateway Flow

- **Input**: Architecturally approved projects from Gate 3 (Architecture Review Board)
- **Process**: Operational readiness validation, support procedure verification, monitoring configuration
- **Output**: Production-ready systems proceed to Gate 5 (Turnover to Operations)
- **Feedback Loop**: Systems requiring operational improvements return with updated procedures
page_texts.18:
[governance/governing-bodies/operational-readiness-test-review.md#exit-criteria]

### Exit Criteria

Systems approved by ORT must demonstrate:

- Complete operational documentation and procedures
- Verified monitoring and alerting configuration
- Validated support capabilities and training completion
- Confirmed performance and capacity readiness
- Operational security compliance validation
